subject: Marketplace private offer — MAP and evaluation timeline
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@orbitcare.io>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Jacobs <tom.jacobs@cloudprocure.com>
Date: 2026-09-28T09:12:00Z
Subject: Marketplace private offer — MAP request

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. OrbitCare would like to move toward a private offer on AWS (we'll also evaluate GCP later in the quarter). Procurement asked us to put together a mutual action plan (MAP) so they can commit to internal approval windows.

Can you share a simple MAP that includes:
- Evaluation milestones (P0/P1 scenarios, perf targets)
- Estimated billing path and invoice cadence for an AWS Private Offer
- Legal/contract touchpoints and expected turnaround times
- Any upfront requirements for Dedicated capacity or Private deployment

We need this by the end of next week to keep the approval on track. I attached a one-page intake from our side.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if that helps.

Elena Morales
Head of Platform Engineering
OrbitCare

Attachment: orbitcare-intake.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@orbitcare.io>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Tom Jacobs <tom.jacobs@cloudprocure.com>
Date: 2026-09-29T16:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Marketplace private offer — MAP request

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. I put together a draft MAP and a short SOW stub that maps to OrbitCare's intake. Attaching both for your procurement team to review. Key highlights up front:

- Evaluation plan (2-week technical eval + 4-week pilot):
  * Week 0: Access & onboarding (private offer activation, credentials, single-day kickoff)
  * Week 1-2: P0 tests (latency at 95th percentile, token-cost targets)
  * Week 3-6: Pilot with a 50k token/day profile and error-rate monitoring
  * Success criteria: 95th p latency < 250ms for 512-token seq; cost within 15% of projection

- Billing path and cadence:
  * We can route the purchase through the AWS Private Offer flow; Redwood will issue monthly invoices to OrbitCare's billing contact linked to the marketplace commitment.
  * For annual commitments we support monthly or quarterly invoicing; PO number required on first invoice.

- Legal & procurement:
  * We expect a 7-10 business day review for our standard MSA + PO terms, faster if your legal uses the marketplace T&Cs.
  * If you need an enterprise amendment, allow 2–3 weeks.

- Dedicated/Private requirements:
  * For predictable throughput we recommend reserving a dedicated pool (min 2 GPUs) during pilot; optional burst for peak testing.

Action items I propose:
1) OrbitCare to confirm procurement contact and required PO template by 2026-10-04.
2) Redwood to share signed MAP v1 (attached) and SOW draft by 2026-10-01.
3) Technical kickoff scheduled for 2026-10-05 (30–45 min).

Attachments: MAP-OrbitCare-v1.xlsx, SOW-draft-OrbitCare.pdf

If that timeline looks tight we can shift the kickoff a week. Let me know what works.

— Logan Wright
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
log an.wright@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Elena Morales <elena@orbitcare.io>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-30T10:21:00Z
Subject: Re: Marketplace private offer — MAP and evaluation timeline

Thanks Logan — quick procurement notes from our side (copying Kimberly for billing/finance):

- PO details: OrbitCare should include their AWS Private Offer ID on the PO. If you send the marketplace acceptance email to procurement@redwood.ai we can reconcile with AWS and ensure invoices link to the offer.
- Taxes & remittance: We will invoice Redwood US entity; please confirm whether OrbitCare requires invoices to be routed to a subsidiary (if so, send tax ID).
- Trial credits & billing hold: We can provide a one-month credit (up to $5k) during pilot; credits will be netted against the first two invoices.
- Invoice cadence preference: monthly is default; we can do quarterly on request for annual commitments.

Procurement asks for the following on the MAP spreadsheet:
- Line item: private offer SKU & expected commitment (e.g., 2 reserved GPUs for 6 months)
- Acceptance criteria checkpoint dates aligned to the evaluation plan above
- Contact fields: billing email, AR contact, PO approver name

Kimberly, can you confirm the invoice lookups and whether we need a separate AR mailbox for OrbitCare?

On the SRE side: we recommend enabling KV prefix caching for the pilot to reduce token costs during peak usage; we'll include configuration notes in the kickoff doc.

— Soojin Lee
Platform Solutions — Redwood Inference

From: Elena Morales <elena@orbitcare.io>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Purchasing Team <procure@orbitcare.io>
Date: 2026-10-02T16:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Marketplace private offer — MAP and evaluation timeline

Logan / Soojin — this looks great and aligns with procurement's expectations. Quick replies inline:

- OrbitCare will include the AWS Private Offer ID on the PO; Procurement is happy with monthly invoices.
- We'll send the PO template and tax ID to Kimberly by EOD Friday (2026-10-08).
- The kickoff on 2026-10-05 works for the technical team — please send the calendar invite.
- We accept the $5k pilot credit; please include how that will appear on the first invoice.

Next steps:
1) OrbitCare to circulate internal PO template by 2026-10-08.
2) Redwood to provide MAP v1 signed copy and attach the same in HubSpot record RDW-5678 by 2026-10-01 (if possible).
3) DocuSign for SOW once PO is in flight — OrbitCare prefers DocuSign links rather than emailed PDFs.

Thanks all — looping in Purchasing for signatures.

Elena Morales
Head of Platform Engineering, OrbitCare
